title: C_FindObjectsInit: missing OPERATION_ACTIVE check
description: C_FindObjectsInit does not check s->find_active before overwriting find_tmpl[]. If called twice without an intervening C_FindObjectsFinal, the second call silently resets the template without clearing find_pos, producing inconsistent search state. PKCS#11 spec requires CKR_OPERATION_ACTIVE when a find is already running.
